children: Bitcoin fell below $57,000, its lowest since September 2024, as $2.4B in futures were liquidated in 24 hours, then rebounded to about $59,300. The Nasdaq fell more than 4% Friday, and Nvidia dropped 14% to a 52-week low, down about $2.7T from its October record. XRP hit 87 cents, and US spot XRP ETF assets slipped below $1B. Kobeissi Letter calls the AI rout a correction, not a popped bubble, while US stocks have lost $6T since October 6. Tap to see what analysts say comes next.Bitcoin Falls Below $57,000 to a Two-Year Low as $2.4 Billion in Liquidations Hit Bullish TradersBitcoin fell below $57,000, its lowest since September 2024, then rebounded to about $59,300, still down about 29% for the quarter. It set a new low in the bear market that began after the peak above $126,000 in October 2025 (about 55% above Friday's low, calculated). It broke below its June low of under $58,000, erasing the September recovery above the 50-week average that Galaxy and others read as a new uptrend. The Nasdaq fell more than 4% Friday to its lowest since April, and gold, copper and Asian stocks also fell. Analysts point to rising real yields as the key driver. Liquidations reached $2.40B per CoinGlass: bitcoin over $1B, ether $545M, and the largest single liquidation a $51.71M bitcoin long. CoinDesk said positioning was heavily tilted toward a bull market, with many traders not expecting a drop below $60,000.Tech Stocks Slide as AI Sentiment Cools, Nvidia Loses $2.7 Trillion in a Month and a HalfNvidia fell 14.01% on November 20 to a 52-week low, with its market cap near $3T, fourth among US stocks after Alphabet overtook it. It is down from a record of about $5.77T set October 6, a drop equal to Amazon's entire market cap. Anthropic gave back most of its debut gains on day two, closing down 8.50% after briefly nearing its $83 IPO price. Media attribute Nvidia's fall to weaker AI sentiment, the broader tech selloff and concerns about the company's accounting.Kobeissi Letter Calls AI Rout a Correction, Not a Popped BubbleUS stocks have lost an average of $225B a day for 31 straight sessions, $6T since the S&P 500's October 6 record. Kobeissi argues capex is the trigger: Amazon, Alphabet, Meta and Microsoft capex hit a record $201.9B in Q3, up $36.9B. Earnings held up, with S&P 500 Q3 EPS up 31.9% year over year. It says the Democratic sweep ended the "Trump Put," that Anthropic's IPO drained liquidity (demand of $400B institutional and $100B retail, nearly eight times the $64.4B sought), and that Nvidia, down 40%, trades at 9x forward earnings. A November 19 short-seller report accused AMD of smuggling chips to China, which the letter calls far from substantiated. The VIX is up more than 100% from its October low. It stops short of calling a bottom, saying another 10% decline would still be a healthy correction.XRP Drops to Two-Year Low Near 87 Cents as Spot ETF Assets Fall Below $1 BillionXRP fell to about 87 cents Saturday, its lowest since November 2024, down about 9% over 24 hours and 11.5% over the week. The five US spot XRP ETFs hold about $990M in net assets against about $1.78B in cumulative inflows; the gap reflects falling market value. Ether dropped more than 10%, SOL more than 9% and Zcash 19%. About $18M of XRP futures were liquidated, roughly 94% longs, and funding turned negative. XRP's daily RSI is below 30, oversold, which can precede short-term rebounds but does not confirm a bottom.China-Related Stocks Mostly Fall on November 21; TSMC Drops 9.48%, Alibaba 2.68%The Nasdaq Golden Dragon China Index fell 3.37%. TSMC -9.48%, ASE Technology -13.84%, XPeng -13.86%, UMC -10.15%, Baidu -6.75%, Li Auto -7.56%, NIO -7.89%, Alibaba -2.68%. H World rose 0.14%.

title: Binance Market Update | Bitcoin Crashes Below $57K as $2.4B Gets Wiped Out. Traders Bet on a Bull Market That Never Came
